notes.title: Update 1.2.0.8, a much needed update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Improving basd on your feedback[/h1]
After a much needed break from development we're coming back to improve the quality of life for RGT. In the coming days Panos plans to bring in some more customization options for characters!

[h1]Time freeze bug[/h1]
We've heard a lot of people bring up the time freezing bug and yet a ton of players were able to play upwards of 50 hours without any issues. Since it didn't seem urgent it got pushed off for a while but we're finally attempting to resolve it. I've made some changes to the code surrounding record deals and booked events that should hopefully prevent anymore time freezes from occuring. As always your feedback is crucial so if you still get the bug please exit the game and email me a copy of your save file so that I may further diagnose the issue.

[h1]Windowed mode is back[/h1]
After a number of complaints we switched the game to borderless windowed instead of normal windowed but it turns out the majority actually prefers windowed mode as that allows the window to be resized freely. So we've returned to that.

[h1]Attempting to increase compatibility[/h1]
This part is a bit technical but we've reduced texture page sizes in hopes of making the game more functional for less capable video cards. Not sure if this will actually solve the problems we've heard from the community but we are hopeful.

[h1]Changelog 1.2.0.8[/h1]
[list][*]Reduced standard texture page size from 8192x8192 to 4096x4096
[*]Switched the game back to Windowed mode
[*]Fixed a possible time stop bug with album finalization
[*]Fixed a possible time stop bug with booked events such as gigs and video clips
[*]Drug Dealer image is properly removed from memory when the popup menu is closed
[*]Minor optimizations to script referencing throughout the game[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.3 Tension fixes, extended resolution support!
notes.notes:
[h1]Tension events[/h1]
Tension reducing events reduce tension by a certain percentage with each band member. This has unfortunately led to a lot of confusion. There were some bugs with tension changes not being saved properly but this has all been fixed.

[h1]Extended resolution support[/h1]
I recently acquired a 4k monitor and realized that Rock God Tycoon doesn't support resolutions beyond 1920x1080. Upon seeing this I decided it was time for a small upgrade to the display system. The game window now centers properly for different resolutions and I've added support for 1366x768 as well as 1360x768 (not true 16:9 which previously led to various issues).

[h1]New hair bug?[/h1]
Not sure why but this started happening...

I'm assuming it is due to the latest updates made to Game Maker but I can't say for sure. It is only this single hair style so it'll just be like this for now.

[*]Block booking of tension reducing events if there isn't enough money

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.2 Balancing and optimizations!
notes.notes:
[h1]Reducing the grind/difficulty[/h1]
Update 1.2.0.0 resulted in an endless grind where money was barely obtainable. The game progression was slowed to nearly a stop and so we listened to what the community had to say about it. As a result of your experiences and voices we have made a number of balance changes. You should be able to progress a lot easier now and a few of the more harsh changes we made have been undone.

[h1]Polishing changes[/h1]
The game now runs in borderless windowed mode which should be a lot less annoying for the majority of users (especially content creators). Additionally I spent about an hour re-writing all of the rectangle drawing in the game to use a more optimal solution that while visually is the same, should result in much better performance. You may also notice a new help icon in the hiring screen if you start a new game. This was added to help prevent new users from using all of their income on hiring initially which often leads to an instant [i]game over[/i].

[h1]Changelog 1.2.0.2[/h1]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list][*]Busking income changed from $7-$10, to $10-$13
[*]Busking fan gain changed from 0-3 to 1-5
[*]Gig burnout gain rate reduced by 50%
[*]Reduced weed overdose gain by 25%
[*]Reduced city hype requirement from 25% of city population to 20%
[*]Overdose threshold raised by 20%
[*]Overdose chance reduced by 12.5%[/list]
[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list][*]Tooltip button added to hiring screen for first time hiring budget
[*]Optimized rectangle draws with custom rectangle drawing, difference should be noticeable for low-end users
[*]Changed windowed mode to borderless[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list][*]Stripclub in Dover now has a background image[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.0 is here at last! Full game rework!
notes.notes:
[h1]At long last![/h1]
Generally I would write out a few paragraphs regarding the update but you can find loads of information about this update in the previous two news posts we posted.

Post #1: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791454901951/announcements/detail/1255787772102967248]Click Here[/url]
Post #2: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791454901951/announcements/detail/1255788411471619310]Click Here[/url]

You'll notice with these changes that the game seems completely different. Tension is handled in a new way and you'll have to manage your money a lot differently.

[h1]Changelog 1.2.0.0[/h1]

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list][*]Character Actions rework, refine skills is now practice skill allowing the player to pick a specific skill for improvement
[*]Removed passive tension deduction at the end of each day
[*]4 new map event types that reduce tension
[*]UI rework for date/time on the Map menu and the main screen.
[*]Map legend and event icons rework. Descriptions for gigs,recording studios and video clip studios are back.
[*]Implemented gig burnout, playing shows too many times at the same location will lead to less people showing up
[*]Rewrote algorithm behind travelling tension, no longer reduces tension and now provides consistent results
[*]Implemented passive character action, "burn out"
[*]Implemented passive character action, "Attending Rehab"
[*]Implemented character overdose
[*]Added new events to various cities[/list]
[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list][*]Opening any menu or pausing in the main hub will stop fast forwarding sounds immediately
[*]Tooltip showing event details has been re-positioned slightly to the left of the icon
[*]Missing a gig due to time passing events will result in fan loss in that gig's city
[*]Polished positioning of map tooltip for city event list
[*]Changed games margin sleep timer from 1ms to 10ms, game should feel smoother
[*]Made click radius for map buttons 1 pixel shorter to prevent overlapping buttons
[*]Tension event where bandmate demands a raise increased demanded raise from 10% to 25%
[*]Calendar tooltip uses the same system as the datebox to show event information
[*]Datebox tooltip UI, shifts position if it is off screen
[*]Booked event messages now shows text more centered
[*]The map and shop transition now use lerp functions to smooth out movement (polished)
[*]Re-balanced gig promotions to allow up to 100% increase in audience attendence (still capped by gig capacity)
[*]Re-balanced shop promotions to better compliment latest gameplay changes
[*]Re-balanced city fan requirements for the first 8 cities
[*]Booked events such as gigs, studios, and video clips now give more tension[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list][*]Travel time tooltip on city map fixed
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed for you to book dates that were supposed to be unavailable on the calendar
[*]Tension and band solidity bars in the band info screen were drawn improperly, fixed
[*]Billboard doesn't update until you scroll, fixed
[*]Map name shown over calendar, fixed
[*]Fixed xp level progression bars, they were not showing the right information at all
[*]Two of the available guitar instruments were on the wrong texture page, fixed (resulting in better performance)
[*]"Sell Songs" menu now properly bounds the mouse box within the song list area
[*]Changed texture pages for pop up messages, improved performance
[*]Changed texture pages for "Monthly Expenses" paper and "Randomize" to run along the Main GUI, improved performance
[*]Dynamic images loaded onto tickets such as the billboard shown when booking a gig were not being unloaded, fixed

notes.title: Update 1.1.4.2 City hype, less annoying random events
notes.notes:
[h1]Quality of life[/h1]
You can now toggle between the normal cursor and the Windows default cursor. F3 to toggle between the two options.
[img=http://i.imgur.com/hxbvPwe.gif][/img]

Cancelling events via the dateboxes shown at the top of the main hub has been around for a while but it wasn't really explained anywhere so there is now a tooltip for it.
[img=http://i.imgur.com/9hYtb8Y.png][/img]

[h1]City hype[/h1]
In an attempt to make the mid to late game more exciting we have added city hype. What this means is that certain cities that you are popular in will reach out to you and offer to pay more to see you perform at one of their local venues. This makes the world feel more active and rewards players for sticking to cities early on. Hopefully this change makes some of the early challenges a little less difficult.

[h1]Event redundancy system[/h1]
Seeing the same random events hundreds of times can get annoying. To fix this we can either add a lot more events (which would involve a lot of writing and programming) or we can extend the life time of the ones we already have. When I wrote the event system originally it did not store any information about the message after it had passed. The new system can track how many times you've seen a message and what choices you have made.

I'm slowly working my way through all the previously created events to allow for a more dynamic and less repetitive experience. An example of this is shown when getting the [i]"dropped money"[/i] event. Instead of always saying, "You found $100!", it will instead (upon its second occurence) say, "You must be a money magnet because you found another $50!". This way it feels a little different and makes starting a new game all the more refreshing.

[h1]Changelog 1.1.4.2[/h1]
[b]New Stuff[/b]
[list][*]Message redundancy system implemented
[*]Added two new message events, (31, 32)
[*]Added two new character descriptions
[*]City hype, if you have at least 25% of a city population as fans, there is a chance they'll get hyped to see you perform and pay extra at venues for a limited time
[*]Cursor can now be toggled between ingame and Windows default with F3
[*]Event cancellation tooltip now displayed when hovering over dateboxes[/list]

[*]Flipping man, fan dream, satanic accusations, and dropped money events have redundancy message modifications[/list]

notes.notes:
[h1]Any updates about planned features?[/h1]
We have a huge list of new features and changes we plan to make. Festivals, awards, and sponsors. The list goes on and on. Right now while Panos is still away I am focusing on improving the game's [i]quality of life[/i]. You'll see that in this update with the changes made to gig performances. We want to reach out to more people as we go so are also focused on talking to you (the community).

Don't feel shy and know that we encourage you to make yourself heard!

And with that, I present to you the long awaited changelog!

[h1]Changelog 1.1.4.0[/h1]
[b]Rhythm Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]There is now an audience that cheers louder depending on how well you perform, currently independent of audience size (we can't afford to hire tons of people to shout for us in a courtyard for an hour)
[*]If you miss notes during a performance, the audio track you are playing will mute until you hit another note
[*]Rhythm delay calibration option enabled
[/list]
[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list][*]Band member and band songs pages have been cleaned up to improve their FPS and reduce file IO
[*]Outlined text is now rendered more efficiently
[*]Optimized the main hub screen excessively, gaining around 500+ potential fps
[*]Removed a compatibility script "string_hash_to_newline()" from a few scripts to improve performance (hundreds more left to remove)
[/list]
[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list][*]Changed song writing action to allow for separate message queues if multiple songs are being produced at once
[*]Current date is now shown on calendar
[*]Event names are displayed once more when hovered over with the mouse
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed song rehearsal experience bug, if band member is writing song, they get 10% rehearsal experience in any song completed
[*]Fixed a serious memory leak with performances, both the fretboard surface and the fretboard sprite list were left in memory
[*]Can no longer book gigs for dates before the current date
[*]Fixed max instrument skill causes skill pop-ups to be cancelled for that character
[*]Video clips and rehearsals were displaying the wrong skill icons from gained XP

notes.title: Update 1.1.2.0 Calendar, Steam Cloud, and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Calendar booking system[/h1]
We have always wanted a touring system and the community has been asking for a way to book events further into the future so we decided it was time to re-design our booking system. The new calendar UI allows for you to book/cancel events as far into the future as you would like. This brings with it an obvious warning... [b]DO NOT BOOK 50 YEARS WORTH OF EVENTS[/b] at once. It will both slow down your game and be a serious pain if you have a sudden change of plans for your band.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/HGlapID.png][/img]

[h1]Steam Cloud[/h1]
A single user suggested that we add Cloud support because he wasn't able to play his save file on his laptop while at work away from home. I felt so bad for him that I spent the necessary time to implement it. I'm sure this is the case for a lot of people that game outside of their home.

[h1]Stability and bug fixes[/h1]
The game isn't bug free obviously as we are a small team but as the programmer, I work [b]VERY[/b] hard to respond to and resolve as many bugs as possible. I think it is important that everyone is aware that we both care A LOT about crashes and even just pesky little bugs. Please report any you run into and you can expect that we'll fix it ASAP.

This build fixes a lot of issues and potential crashes players may have ran into previously. The list is too big to go over here so you'll have to refer to the changelog below if you are interested in specifics.

[h1]Changelog 1.1.2.0[/h1]
[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]Calendar booking system
[*]Steam Cloud support
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list][*]Recording studios with higher rating affect recording/rehearsal quality more
[/list]
[b]Minor changes[/b]
[list][*]You can now cancel events by pressing Ctrl+Left MB on occupied date boxes
[*]Santa Fe and Albuquerque are no longer in opposite positions on the map
[*]Easton and Dover are no longer in opposite positions on the map
[*]Confirmation message when cancelling album finalization
[*]Maximum profit is now shown on gig booking UI
[*]Randomize button for name choice and band choice
[*]When writing a song that already exists in your files, you will not be prompted to write the song
[*]The "Easy Song Access (F2)" will no longer allow you to write song names that already exists in your files
[/list][b]Bug fixes and performance[/b]
[list][*]Studios were not properly including their quality when calculating the rehearsal experience gained
[*]Removed username based song directory (Will automatically delete for previous users)
[*]Wrote a conversion script to automatically convert old song files to the new name format upon launching this update or a newer one
[*]Fixed possible crash with rehearsals due to corrupted save files
[*]Minor event message system is now nullified by other present events, this will prevent overlapping events
[*]Fixed memory leak and possible crashes due to the player missing recording/rehearsal events
[*]Removed a lot of code occurences of string_hash_to_newline() that were added when porting from GMS 1 to GMS 2, this could slightly increase performance in some places
[*]Hovering your mouse over the date boxes while a message is being displayed will no longer trigger the tooltips for it[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1.0 Drums, bug fixes, and user suggestions!
notes.notes:
[h1]Drums are now available![/h1]
For a while now only the guitar has been available for the rhythm gameplay, this is no longer the case. The drums are now available in all difficulties and tempos. It has taken a lot of time to complete due to the number of pattern files required (510 to be exact).

[h1]User suggestions and further development[/h1]
We are still completely open to new suggestions and are still working day and night on the game. This is a game we know needs some touching-up and you can expect us to continue working on the game for quite some time. We just want to clarify for our customers/future users that we don't see the game as finished but it is (in our opinion) well beyond Early Access. There is lots of content already and even more on the way.

This game has been a giant project for us and so we don't plan to turn our backs on it until we've completed it. Coming from a cynical point of view you may think we are just trying to show fake dedication but even from a business stand point, it wouldn't make sense for us to leave the game in its current state after all that we have put into it already. Imagine a classic game like Roller Coaster Tycoon with half the content it currently has. A game like that wouldn't sell for 18 years past its original release. We want a game that lasts for the long run, and beats out any attempted clones.

[h1]Changelog 1.1.1.0[/h1]
[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]Drums are now available for rhythm gameplay
[/list]

[list][*]Bandmates salary requests have a cooldown period of 3 months

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.0 Steam Workshop, Improved Song Creation
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam Workshop![/h1]
It is here at last! You can download and upload your tracks from the Song Creation tool. We decided that instead of generating songs, it would be better to download handmade tracks from other users.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/cDc1NWB.png][/img]

Once you open the workshop you should see this menu... (unless you're offline)

[img=http://i.imgur.com/lDAvW1g.png][/img]

Uploading a song is easy! All you have to do is press upload and then you'll be taken to this menu. Once there all you need to do is fill out the required information and then, press [i]Upload[/i]!

[img=http://i.imgur.com/Kr5c4or.png][/img]

[url=http://www.rockgodtycoon.com/steam-workshop.html]Upload Instructions[/url]

We have really worked hard to make the whole process smooth and easy to understand. We hope that everyone enjoys this new feature!

[h1]Imrpoved Song Creation[/h1]
The Song Creation tool has always been a bit clunky and for good reason. Creating an entire game and then a whole tool on the side isn't easy.

Now tracks can be paused and played from any position (thanks to some math related changes). You can also overlap tracks without getting audio overlaps.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/NNXg5YD.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog 1.1.0.0[/h1]
[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]Steam Workshop for Song Creation
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list][*]Lowered band member desired salary from 15% to 8% of months revenue

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.4 Checkpoints, bandmate raises, and polish!
notes.notes:
We are starting to get back into the flow of things and regaining momentum. You can expect awesome changes very soon. Meanwhile, enjoy this rock'n update.

[h1]XP Bars (user request)[/h1]
You can now see just how far along your character is with whichever skill you are working on. The XP system uses a 1 to 100 point system for each level so you should be able to see those numbers a little easier now.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/7T9OGGS.png][/img]
[i]Band info menu[/i]
[img=http://imgur.com/oBG3W92.png][/img]
[i]Band management menu[/i]


[h1]Checkpoint System (user request)[/h1]
We've heard a lot of people voices regarding the persistance of save files. We intended for the game to be this way but it is unusually cruel that when you lose, you lose everything forever. So to counter act our own design for the betterment of Rock God Tycoon society, we've added a checkpoint system.

Every 6 months the game will automatically backup your save file and so next time you get a game over, it will revert to that backed up save file. That way you don't lose everything.

[h1]Difficulty, where is it?[/h1]
The first run you have in RGT generally results in a game over around month 3. The 2nd run, you excel and beat the game with ease. The end game feels like nothing is happening and that you may as well start over. We've noticed this and [i](thanks to all of you awesome people)[/i] have made some big changes.

[b]Two major changes include:[/b]
1. Bandmates now request increases in salary. Their request is based on the income you've made that month. This means that salary scales with your income. It isn't too ridiculous so you can still get rich easily but maintaining a band is nowhere near as easy as it once was.

2. Less fans arrive at shows. Previously 25% to 50% of fans would arrive at shows. You could busk for a week and then make lots of mulla at gigs. Now it is 14% to 16% of fans that arrive at shows. This should make promotions more viable and progression less of a landslide to victory.

[h1]Changelog 1.0.0.4[/h1]
[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]Half-year checkpoint backup system
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list][*]Bandmates occasionally request salary increases (15% of monthly income)
[*]Reduced the number of fans that arrive at gigs, previously 25% to 50% of fans arrived, now it is 14% to 16%
[/list]
[b]Minor changes[/b]
[list][*]Equip button locked in when already equipped (vehicle shop menu)
[*]Props and vehicles can now be sold via the shop
[*]XP bars in band info/band management for skills
[*]Scroll menu focus gained via mouse hover
[*]Random song name button for song writing
[/list][b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list][*]Loans would give you $1,000 at the end of each month instead of deducting it[/list]

[h1]Steam Workshop support in development[/h1]
We can now confirm that Steam Workshop support is in the works. We've already got song creation submissions working. We are now designing menus for it and you can likely expect it to be available in the next update. It will be replacing the [i]Generate[/i] button in the Song Creation tool. Now you can just select a song you've subscribed to and instantly have all the patterns placed in Song Creation.

[h1]Drums, rhythm gameplay[/h1]
I've nearly completed the drum files for the rhythm gameplay. I'm approximately 70% through them and so you can possibly expect that to be available in the next update as well.

notes.title: Full release! Update 1.0.0.0
notes.notes:
[h1]The big surprise[/h1]
Today at 6am PST we launched into full release! Along with this changed state of release, we have brought an absolutely ridiculous amount of content. Without talking about everything we will breifly go over some of the major changes.

We want to thank everyone that has stayed  involved with the early access and has helped us improve the game to reach the state it's in today. We couldn't have done it without the amazing support and feedback from everyone.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/qhmKTLF.png][/img]

[h1]47 more cities and more assets coming soon[/h1]
Hey guys, Panos here. I have been working really hard to complete the additional 47 cities that were missing from the game. I am confident that there will be no problems with the new cities but in case I am wrong feel free to contact us. 
More content regarding instruments and props will be added soon, as well as new backgrounds for recording studios and video clip studios. If you have more awesome ideas for graphic assets you would love to see in the game feel free to let us know.

[h1]Gig reviews are working[/h1]
This has been an issue with Rock God Tycoon since before early access and I just never got a chance to actually fix the issues. Now you'll see your band get 2's and 3's from reviews early on (not just 1's every time). You will also notice that reviews won't repeat themselves anymore.

[h1]Youtubers/Streamers (content creators), resolution settings[/h1]
A lot of content creators have made themselves heard regarding the lack of resolution options in the game. You can now make these changes within the video settings. The resolutions available will be based on your monitors aspect ratio. You can still manually resize the window of course.

[h1]Character perks[/h1]
This is another feature that has been missing since day 1. There are now 5 perks and I recommend you read the change log to find out what each of them do. We will eventually make a guide/wiki or more ingame information for all of these small side features.

[h1]New achievements[/h1]
Originally there were only 11 achievements but no game is complete on Steam without at least 20 (in my opinion at least). Panos created some lovely art for the new achievements and we hope you enjoy them.

notes.title: Update 0.5.7.2 Engine update and more props!
notes.notes:
[h1]New homes and new props[/h1]
It has taken longer than expected but at last we present to you... Two new homes, and 12 new props! You'll have to check out the new props yourself in game under the [i]Speakers[/i] tab in the prop shop. The new homes are unlocked through story progression which will happen naturally as you play the game. Make sure you don't slack off though because if you do, you might not be able to afford the rent!

Below is a picture of my band enjoying their new crib. Yes, my bands name is [i]Ass[/i].
[img=http://i.imgur.com/nInLSaZ.png][/img]

[h1]Taking suggestions[/h1]
We constantly go back to and read all of your suggestions. We ask that you post suggestions in the relevant section of the steam community hub. Commenting on someone elses thread is likely going to result in us missing it in the future. You have all been awesome so far and really have helped us improve this game. So once again, thank you to everybody who is a part of this community.

[h1]That annoying crash on exit[/h1]
One of the main reasons I have spent today porting the game into the new engine is because of this crashing issue. I believe that this engine is a bit more stable than the one we've been using so we've crossed our fingers and are taking the dive. Of course we can't guarantee anything as we are tiny team and I (as the programmer) tend to do most of the playtesting so there is very little we can do to predict the future. However we got this far without too many horrible issues so you can probably trust us.

[h1]Changelog Version 0.5.7.2[/h1]
[list][*]Map date fixed
[*]Fixed date system for all events
[*]Made changes to the prop placement system that may lead to some odd depth issues but due to the nature of the sprites being used, this can not be changed
[*]Removed empty pattern, Bass tempo 80, 2b (2)
[*]Shop image system for props has been changed to allow for larger sized props
[*]Rewrote prop shop to allow for more than 10 props to be displayed
[*]Added new prop type "speakers"
[*]Added 12 new props
[*]Game over loan from parents allows for a one time recovery if your financial balance falls below $0
[*]Recording studios now open under rehearsals by default instead of recording
[*]Having a album released would cause the money gain sound to play at the end of each day
[*]Completed contracts now have a checkmark shown above them
[*]Record deal contract showed the wrong date under "Current Date"
[*]Contracts that require songs to have a video clip also require that song to be recorded at a studio (this was originally intended but overlooked while being implemented)
[*]Contracts that allowed for you to play at multiple gigs as a requirement were not counting gigs completed

[*]Two new homes
[*]Switched to Game Maker: Studio 2
[/list]

[i]You do [b]NOT[/b] have to start a new game to experiene these changes. Save files have been made compatible since the day of release. This will be continued for as long as possible.[/i]

notes.notes:
[h1]Song writing is here![/h1]
It took us forever but at last we have delivered to you... song writing. It appears to be fully functional and bug-free but that's the point of early access. We need you awesome people to let us know if you have any issues/crashes with this latest update. I personally played for about an hour without a crash earlier today so I'm assuming there won't be a ton of issues.

You can access song writing by completing the [i]Write a song[/i] character action. Upon completion you will be prompted to either write the song in the song editor or skip it. We plan to make song writing more accessible in future updates but this will have to do for now.

[h1]Seabass, balancing[/h1]

notes.title: Update 0.5.6.8, New events, bug fixes, and balancing!
notes.notes:
[h1]An update, at last![/h1]
A lot of people have spoken up and discussed the lack of balance in certain areas of the game. We want to thank each of you for contributing to the development prcoess.

For those of you who have already played the game a fair bit, we recommend reading through the changelog below, travelling was broken up until now. It has been completely rebalanced and fixed to allow short travel without too much tension gain.

[h1]What about song writing?[/h1]
We are still finalizing song writing. At this moment, we need a few more art assets and I need to clean up/polish some of the code. I think it is a fair estimate to say it should be in the next update, or the one following that one. At this moment, we are just trying to get back into the swing of things.

[h1]Changelog Version 0.5.6.8[/h1]

[b]New stuff[/b]
[list][*]Klepto event system implemented
[*]2 new klepto events
[*]4 new minor events[/list]

[b]Bug fixes, Optimizations[/b]
[list][*]Fixed bug, character randomization wasn't calculating the price of clothing properly.
[*]Fixed issue, clicking the pause menu buttons before the menu finished transitioning caused a crash
[*]Fixed bug/design issue with hired band members, it has been disabled for hired bandmates but remains active for your character.
[*]Fixed bug, Van now travels at intended speed
[*]Fixed bug, clothing/instrument purchases are now cleared from memory when you quit a game
[*]Fixed bug, travelling now uses vehicles travel speed in equation properly
[*]Fixed bug, travelling without certain band members being hired would result in tension not being added to certain roles
[*]Fixed possible crash when saved game gets corrupted (in some rare cases)
[*]Cleaned up memory on exit in hopes of preventing game crash on exit (doesn't work but might help in future builds)[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list][*]Balance changes have been made to travelling, 5% is the minimum for tension gain (used to be 20%), the amount of tension gained from travel is higher in general though,this all not counting the vehicles travel speed into the equation
[*]Travel times for vehicles have been modified, the "Car (Used)" is a lot slower now and all other vehicles will now be quite a bit faster[/list]

If you crash on exit, go to this folder location [i]%localappdata%\CrashDumps[/i] and delete the files there. Each crash results in a 10mb dump file being generated which adds up fast. We are awaiting an engine update at the moment but we assume the next update will fix the crashing issue.

[i]You do [b]NOT[/b] have to start a new game to experiene these changes. Save files have been made compatible since the day of release. This will be continued for as long as possible.[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.5.4.3 New cities, bug fixes, and polish
notes.notes:
First off, we would like to thank you all for the amazing feedback and endless patience. We've not had a single negative interaction yet and so we really have to thank all of you for that.

Some important changes to take notice of...
We've lowered the price of the used car to $2,250 instead of $3,500. This is so you can choose to purchase it early on and not get a game over as a result.

Rent now increases by $20 a month until it reaches $2,000. This will force players to leave the beginning city but also increase the challenge of the game to match your progression. We aren't sure exactly how this will actually affect things but we want to try it out so let us know what you think!

[h1][u]Panos (Artist)[/u][/h1]
Hey guys, just want to let you know that I am focusing on creating a lot more instruments right now, starting with guitars. I will create iconic guitars from famous guitarists as well as some designs of my own. You can join our public Discord since I am asking for suggestions from time to time, so if you have a specific design on mind let me know there.

[h1][u]Seabass (Programmer)[/u][/h1]
I've been putting about 85% of my time into bug fixing. I think the majority of issues have all been addressed but more will appear as we move forward. On the side of all of that though, I've been focusing on balance and polish.

An example of this is the new notifications (artwork thanks to Panos). It seems a lot of people weren't aware of the hiring date or when rent was due. This should make it a bit more obvious.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/K3U9ARQ.png[/img]

Another polishing touch I've implemented (due to a suggestion from one you awesome people) is a way to see the city, event, and time you have booked. This should be really helpful when you have are planning out your week.
[img]http://imgur.com/nUkuTPD.gif[/img]

I'd like everyone to be aware that we do know that tension needs to be explained better and shown in a more convenient fashion. We are deciding the best way to do and you will see it added in the next update.

[h1][b]Changelog 0.5.4.3[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Added 3 new cities,
[list][*]Santa Fe - 1 gig, 1 record label
[*]Bismarck - 1 gig, 1 video clip studio
[*]Flagstaff - 1 gig, 1 video clip studio[/list]
[*]Band hires now only apply for available positions
[*]Time remains paused (if it was previously paused) when returning to the garage screen
[*]Studios can no longer be booked without first selecting at least one band member
[*]Increased minimum bandmate salaries
[*]Song preference list is now saved/loaded
[*]Fixed bug, msg_event_minor_3
[*]Can no longer hire bandmates once you have four bandmates
[*]Dateboxes have tooltips that show event information
[*]Fixed issue where random events could occur when a booked event would occur leading to the time stopping permanently
[*]Recording analysis will now show "-" instead of "-100%" for songs that don't have all four roles recorded yet
[*]Studios/Video Clips can no longer be booked if you don't have the money required to book (before this would just be an instant game over)
[*]Band rating cache is now updated whenever you hire/fire band members
[*]Re-enabled tension event 2, band mates can get fed up and demand a raise if your band tension gets too high, they can also quit
[*]Price of "Car (Used)" reduced to $2,250 (ws $3,500 before)
[*]Fixed a bug in prop placement, placing a prop onto a different prop would cause the already placed prop to disappear instead of returning to your inventory
[*]All minor events involving money loss have a higher minimum cash required to occur
[*]Nerfed Firstborn Studio, studio quality to 10% (used to be 50%)
[*]Rent now increases by $20 a month until it reaches $2,000
[*]Implemented notifications for hiring and rent[/list]

You do [b]NOT[/b] have to start a new game to experiene these changes. Save files have been made compatible since the day of release. This will be continued for as long as possible.

notes.title: Update 0.5.4.1, tons of polish and fixes!
notes.notes:
We have heard about bugs and various issues over the past 12 hours thanks you! Your feedback is so very appreciated.

As the programmer on our team, I couldn't help but feel personally responsible and so I went ahead and fixed every issue I could find. I also implemented some extra polish in places where it felt necessary.

This patch is kind of like a large hotfix more than anything so you can still expect another update very soon with more content related additions!

This update shouldn't affect any previously saved games!

[h1]Change Log for 0.5.4.1[/h1]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list][*]Nerfed instrument skill growth rate[/list]
[b]New Stuff[/b]
[list][*]3 new minor events[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed "Fan Gain" effect spamming like crazy when some messages were displayed
[*]Fixed character actions not being cleared when exiting the ingame screen
[*]Fixed a minor event that gave the player writing skill but did not popup the attribute icon
[*]Fixed bug that resulted in bandmates (not the player) gaining large amounts of skill from any sort of skill growth
[*]Fixed some tension related bugs that resulted in bad filing reading and incorrect caching
[*]Fixed recording studio songlist offseting song list due to unavailable songs
[*]Fixed a mistype in a minor event, said "Harambe Records" instead of "Slow YoYo Records"
[*]Fixed a mistype in a minor event, said "Harambe Records" instead of "Slow YoYo Records"
[*]Temporarily disabling a tension event where a band member can quit due to a lot of reports regarding crashing when the event occurs
[*]Fixed a game breaking bug with album publishing, failing the requirements could lead to a gray screen and the game stopping time progression[/list]
[b]Polishing[/b]
[list][*]You can no longer fire bandmates if you don't have the minimum money required
[*]Contracts now show '[complete]' next to tasks you've finished
[*]Contract failure at the final publishing prompt will now show you how long the cooldown is for that contract label and the fine amount
[*]Added tooltips to the contract finalization prompt, if you put your mouse over 'Publish' the game will tell you what needs to be changed for the album to be published
[*]Added tooltips to the band management 'Fire' button, it now will tell you how much you must pay a band member before firing them[/list]

[h1]Here's a tip![/h1]
Press [i]F1[/i] to open the debug info box! This gives you an easy way to see memory usage and framerate. Enjoy all of you FPS squeezers!
